answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 528 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the horizon queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Slashing removes 52 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
